coordinate_convention: world meters, +Z gravity-up; rigid 4x4 column-vector pose; hanger local +Y up, Z arm span, X thickness

threshold_rationale.lift: 5 cm median collar / hanger-origin rise from initial frame; hem clearance unnecessary.
threshold_rationale.insertion: Both outer shoulder probes at local Z=+/-0.15m, Y=-.075m must be enclosed by the capped garment. Additional inner probes at Z=+/-0.06,+/-0.10m diagnose partial insertion. Each arm must be within .035m of actual material triangles and the finite neck segment must intersect the actual collar cap. A 60%-span compressed final garment encloses inner sections but exposes both outer probes and is rejected.
threshold_rationale.hook: Finite rack cylinder axis crosses hanger plane within calibrated hook pocket, local Y .0855 +/- .006m, Z .0145 +/- .007m; cylinder radius .01155m and hook crown Y .101m. Require upright cosine .9 and axis/plane-normal cosine .6.
limitations: One positive demonstration calibrates this profile, not universal physical correctness.
Capping true openings by triangle fans approximates an enclosed volume. Strongly nonplanar/self-intersecting garments can make ray parity ambiguous.

Three independent ray directions use majority parity. Thin-sheet crossings can move an inner probe outside; both outer probes are mandatory. Enclosure plus proximity is geometric evidence, not force/contact measurement.
No hand-release event or score prerequisite is inferred.
threshold_rationale.material_integrity: Both global and true collar-edge median current/rest ratios must lie in [.5,1.5]. Rest lengths use unchanged first raw frame. This rejects local collar collapse missed by a global median and conservatively withholds garment predicates during excessive collar stretching in the reference (observed peak1.6891; frames980-1038 exceed1.5). Hanger pickup remains independent.
